title: HPI-CT: Healthcare Program Integrity Control Toolkit
description:
HPI-CT is a free, open toolkit that helps healthcare payers, providers and program-integrity agencies find and close the internal-control gaps that fraud, waste and abuse exploit — before payment. Aligned to the GAO Green Book (2025) and COSO.

It includes 172 workflow-integrated controls (78 preventive, 87 detective, 7 corrective) across 10 modules, a 246-question evidence-anchored self-assessment mapped to the Green Book's five components and seventeen principles, a control-failure diagnosis matrix, a regulatory rules dictionary, a data-source registry, and de-identified case exemplars distilled from 1,586 coded U.S. DOJ healthcare-fraud enforcement actions (2023–2026), each mapped to the control that failed. The toolkit runs entirely offline in a browser — no server, no account, and nothing you type leaves your machine.

Code is licensed MIT; content and data CC BY 4.0. Advisory only: it recommends controls and decides nothing. All case references are allegations from public sources and defendants are presumed innocent. Created and maintained by Nicholas Nyarko in a personal capacity from public sources.
